description: A demo HTML file showcasing the use of CodeMirror's multiplexing mode to switch between HTML and plain text modes within the same editor, including embedded JavaScript to define and initialize the multiplexing mode.

methods.name: defineMode
methods.description: Defines a new CodeMirror mode with multiplexing capabilities for syntax highlighting.

methods.name: getMode
methods.description: Retrieves a specific mode based on configuration and mode name.

methods.name: multiplexingMode
methods.description: Creates a multiplexing mode that switches between multiple inner modes based on delimiters.

methods.name: fromTextArea
methods.description: Initializes a CodeMirror editor instance from a textarea element.
